recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a bounded source fix for an active parallel definition; if an external Word source for the glossary is later restored and used for regeneration, mirror the same wording there.
issue_request: FHIR-38927 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked to remove 'frozen' from the sentence defining a document as a frozen set of resources, while retaining frozen resource versions in the document-instance sentence.
initial_application: Git commit 336f6adee7e632a0486a3514e1797d1bf4b6f574 applied the main source/documents.html change on 2023-02-15 by changing the first document definition sentence to 'A document is a set of resources...' and leaving the following frozen-versions sentence. It did not update the active glossary Document entry, which still said 'immutable set of resources'.
additional_context: source/documents.html is active via source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini and already matches the approved wording. source/help.html is also active as Glossary #1 and in publish.ini, so its parallel 'immutable set' definition was a current-spec inconsistency. FHIR-38929 and FHIR-38930 are adjacent same-family document-introduction issues already represented on the combined branch, and community searches found no conflicting discussion beyond FHIR-I minutes confirming the FHIR-38927 vote.
reconciliation: Changed source/help.html so the glossary Document entry says 'A document is a set of resources with a fixed presentation...' instead of 'an immutable set of resources'. No change was made to source/documents.html because it already preserves the approved distinction between the document definition and specific frozen versions in a document instance.
source_changes: source/help.html: changed the glossary Document definition from 'an immutable set of resources' to 'a set of resources'.
